content.short: A Fully Open-Source Business Intelligence API Layer For Cardano
content.description:
CardanoBI is the first fully Open-Source Business Intelligence API Layer for Cardano.

We provide on-chain analytics and enable new data-driven services.

Our API is organized in 3 domains: Core, Business Intelligence (BI) and Partners.

Core: all on-chain data of Cardano (accounts, blocks, transactions, contracts, pools....)

Business Intelligence (BI): data derived from Core offering offering analytics data points

Partners: on-chain and off-chain data, showcasing the business value outcome of Projects delivering utility on Cardano (think of it as the Bloomberg of Cardano where Financial Institutions, News Agencies, Trades alike can get access to the business data of Cardano products (Oracle, DEX, Defi ....)
